$comment: Single source for the Skills bundle's tool facts (plan 09 §4 K5, §5.1). `tool_contract` is stamped into every SKILL.md by scripts/skills/build-skills.mjs and must equal src/mcp/registry.ts TOOL_CONTRACT once the registry exports it; `tools` are the 19 Phase-1a P0 tools (plan 07 C3, plan 10 §3.1a) and must equal tests/smoke/expected-tools.json `core` once it exists. `write_tools` may be named only by the `apply` Skill (not shipped in 1a); `disallowed_tools` is the frontmatter deny-list every other Skill carries (plan 09 K3).
